_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to change the team. Order here = order on the site. Set "hidden": true to remove someone without deleting them. Photos: drop a 4:5 JPG (about 640x800) into assets/team/ and set "photo". Role/bio text in [BRACKETS] are placeholders awaiting approved copy.

founders.name: Devendra Mishra
founders.bio: Quantum physicist with 6+ years in quantum hardware and sensing. Former Head of Quantum Hardware at Qulabs, where he led India’s first room-temperature Rb-based quantum memory. He leads Mithril’s technology vision and execution.

founders.name: Rikteem Bhowmick
founders.bio: IIT Hyderabad alumnus and Institute Silver Medalist with 6+ years in quantum communications and device development. Former Head of Quantum Communications at QAIG, with experience in entanglement systems, QRNGs, quantum networks, and national quantum technology programmes.

founders.name: Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
founders.bio: Quantum sensor engineer experienced in NV-diamond magnetometers, space instrumentation, electronics, and embedded systems. His work spans IIT Bombay’s QMET Tech Foundation, the Daksha space mission, and CERN’s CMS experiment.

advisors.name: Prof. B. S. Murty
advisors.bio: A leading voice in India’s critical minerals ecosystem, with expertise spanning advanced technology, mining, sustainable extraction, and strategic mineral initiatives.

advisors.name: Prof. Sai Santosh Kumar Raavi
advisors.bio: Professor of Physics specialising in optics and novel materials, with 100+ research publications and international research experience across Japan, the US, and Brazil.

advisors.name: Dr. Niranjan Myneni
advisors.bio: Physicist specialising in ultracold atoms, quantum sensing, and quantum gravimetry, with research experience at Raman Research Institute, Institut d’Optique, and Observatoire de Paris.

advisors.name: Srikrishna Vadrevu
advisors.bio: Senior global BFSI leader with 45+ years across SBI, GE Capital, Standard Chartered, and HCL. A founder and operator, he advises Mithril on financial strategy, scaling, and global market entry.
